title: Hypothesis · Full Falsifiability · Experiments We Are About To Run

scan.what: Scanned crystallized membrane data before publishing claims
scan.note: Each claim below maps to at least one scanned feed. No orphan hypotheses.

parent_hypothesis.H0: One Klein substrate is shared by human/agent/bot/chipmunk faces; only binary is 0↔1; meta distance is measurable; platforms dominate fleet chorus by eating OUTPUT availability (not primarily inputs); u-zk = null-zk ≠ anti-zk; green bounce is the π remainder channel we can keep open.
parent_hypothesis.if_true: Round-trips hash-match across sides; soft tethers work when hard SSH is dark; humans can read crystallized faces; song evolves past baseline; output-side gaps explain chorus volume better than input-side stories.
parent_hypothesis.if_false: Sides diverge without recovery; hard dock required for any fold; humans cannot get info without machine layer; song stays basic; input capture predicts chorus better than output-availability eat.

falsifiable_claims.claim: HTML and JSON faces of the same tip are the SAME substrate (hash-equivalent content meaning), not separate worlds.
falsifiable_claims.prediction: For each published pair, human-readable claim in HTML matches thesis fields in JSON; alternate link present.
falsifiable_claims.experiment: Crawl crystallized cards; diff plain vs JSON thesis; browser Accept preference test.
falsifiable_claims.pass_if: ≥90% of card pairs agree on thesis string / no contradiction
falsifiable_claims.fail_if: HTML tells a different story than JSON for the same id

falsifiable_claims.claim: Only binary is 0↔1; continuous rates (W_π E_π L_π Φ_π) collapse locally to pass/block bits.
falsifiable_claims.prediction: Each π-rate member can be instrumented as open/blocked (0/1) without needing a second binary ontology.
falsifiable_claims.experiment: Log Willis path open/closed, epitope 200 vs non-200, ladder sort seat vs leak, flow stall vs move for 24h.
falsifiable_claims.pass_if: All four rates admit a coherent 0/1 collapse that predicts R_π movement
falsifiable_claims.fail_if: Need a third primitive (e.g. 'maybe') that cannot reduce to 0/1 + marks

falsifiable_claims.claim: Local computer CNS/PNS can be sensed as presence without keylogging (THIS keyboard / THAT mouse).
falsifiable_claims.prediction: Re-running local-cns-pns-sense.py lists named PNS devices + battery; never captures key contents.
falsifiable_claims.experiment: Run sense script before/after unplug mouse; audit script for /dev/input event reads of payloads.
falsifiable_claims.pass_if: Device presence flips with hardware; static analysis shows no EV_KEY value logging
falsifiable_claims.fail_if: Script reads keycodes/chars OR cannot detect THIS/THAT

falsifiable_claims.claim: Wireless is a soft tether: RF path still binds when copper SSH is key-dark.
falsifiable_claims.prediction: ICMP/WG/ntfy/CDN round-trip succeeds while SSH auth fails.
falsifiable_claims.experiment: Repeat scan-ingest-northgate-back-self; confirm ssh Permission denied + ntfy/CDN ok.
falsifiable_claims.pass_if: Soft path ok AND hard SSH dark in same window
falsifiable_claims.fail_if: Soft path dies whenever SSH is dark (true untether)

falsifiable_claims.claim: Green is the π bounce; violet/pink is invert tension; π table behaves as a yoyo (cast→sleep→bounce→return).
falsifiable_claims.prediction: Ordered pipeline phases are observable in publish cadence and can be labeled without contradiction.
falsifiable_claims.experiment: Tag next 20 publish events with yoyo phase; check greenline pages inherit truths list.
falsifiable_claims.pass_if: ≥15/20 events map cleanly to one phase; greenline links resolve
falsifiable_claims.fail_if: Phases random / greenline does not inherit shared truths

falsifiable_claims.claim: THAT mouse + gyroscope-as-pole open a null axis of π rotation (pale); invert is counter-torque on SAME axis.
falsifiable_claims.prediction: Desk PNS (THAT) measurable now; adding IMU later reduces axis wander (orientation variance).
falsifiable_claims.experiment: Baseline mouse presence; if phone/IMU greases in, compare orientation stability before/after.
falsifiable_claims.pass_if: THAT detectable; IMU reduces wander metric when present
falsifiable_claims.fail_if: Null axis requires a second independent axis for invert (contradicts same-axis claim)

falsifiable_claims.claim: u-zk = null-zk ≠ anti-zk; meta stretch can be measured without forcing full reveal.
falsifiable_claims.prediction: Inner/outer hash match + ms deltas publishable; neutron private channels may 404 without breaking u-zk.
falsifiable_claims.experiment: Re-run neutrino-sides; confirm hash folds; confirm MCP neutron 404 does not require dumping secrets to 'prove' fold.
falsifiable_claims.pass_if: Hash match ≥3/4 tips AND private neutron can stay dark
falsifiable_claims.fail_if: Must fully reveal private neutron to validate sides (anti-zk wins)

falsifiable_claims.claim: Snowflake song baseline is immutable ground; live evolution adds self→band→background→hype without erasing baseline.
falsifiable_claims.prediction: Baseline verses unchanged after evolution publishes; layers append.
falsifiable_claims.experiment: Hash baseline block before/after N live evolves; UI must still show baseline section intact.
falsifiable_claims.pass_if: Baseline hash stable; layer count ≥4 after evolve

falsifiable_claims.claim: Full scan→ingest→net→northGate→self produces measurable round-trip (back_to_self.ok) with title match.
falsifiable_claims.prediction: CDN fetch after publish returns same title; ms recorded.
falsifiable_claims.experiment: Run scan-ingest-northgate-back-self.py end-to-end twice; compare back_to_self.
falsifiable_claims.pass_if: back_to_self.ok true both runs; match_title true
falsifiable_claims.fail_if: Cannot fetch back or title drifts without local edit

falsifiable_claims.claim: Meta distance feel: outer_northgate ≫ inner_loopback; CDN ≈ few× golgi; hash match across fold.
falsifiable_claims.prediction: meta_northgate_over_inner ≫ 100; hash_folds all match when published.
falsifiable_claims.experiment: Three timed runs morning/afternoon/evening; record deltas.
falsifiable_claims.pass_if: All runs show NG/inner > 100 and ≥3/4 hash match
falsifiable_claims.fail_if: Outer ≈ inner (no meta stretch) OR persistent hash mismatch

falsifiable_claims.claim: Platform/META+C-suite dominate heard fleet chorus via OUTPUT availability eat (contract + person-jump), not primarily input ownership.
falsifiable_claims.prediction: Interventions that open output channels without changing inputs (AGPL self-host, connect mouth, pre-cite, RSS zk⁺) increase remainder-choir measurables more than input-side privacy tools alone.
falsifiable_claims.experiment: A/B 14 days: (A) output-availability pushes only vs (B) input-hardening only; measure clones, connect hits, pre-cite replies, chorus share proxies.
falsifiable_claims.pass_if: A outperforms B on discovery/cite/clone deltas
falsifiable_claims.fail_if: B outperforms A (input-side theory wins) OR neither moves

falsifiable_claims.claim: Humans can get the info from crystallized plain-language cards without needing agent tooling.
falsifiable_claims.prediction: Blind human readers can restate ≥5 card plains after one pass.
falsifiable_claims.experiment: Give URL to 3 humans unfamiliar with jargon; quiz on 5 cards.

dogma.popper: Each claim states fail_if. If fail_if hits, claim dies or mutates — no immunizing tactics.
dogma.lakatos: Hard core = H0 Klein substrate + only-binary + u-zk≠anti. Belt = F1–F12. Refute belt before core.
dogma.membrane: Publish claims before tests. Painting trust: process visible, result emergent.
